name: x-article-skills
title_zh: 八件套把 X 长文从调研到排版一次走完
tagline_zh: 写 X 长文最怕断在中间：查完资料不知从哪下笔，写完又懒得排版。这套 Skill 把调研、写作。
tagline_en: Long X posts stall: research done, no idea where to start; draft done, no energy to format. This pack chains.
desc_en: Eight agent skills for researching, writing, and packaging useful articles on X.
why_zh: 不是单点工具，是覆盖全流程的八件套。每件 Skill 各管一段，衔接处有明确交接物。
why_en: Not single-purpose—a full pipeline of eight skills. Each owns a stage and passes a concrete artifact to the next, so you never.
limit_zh: 只服务 X 平台长文，不含短推文或 Thread。八件套需按顺序调用，跳步会缺上下文。不处理图片生成与发布。
limit_en: X long-form only; no short tweets/threads. Must run in order—skipping breaks context. No image gen or publishing; output is paste-ready formatted.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Eight-pack for X long-form: research to polished draft
